events.ONCE: one completed activation per save-slot/scenario, including empty-chest outcome
events.CHARONCE: one completed activation per persistent party-member GUID/scenario
events.INF: repeat only after completion, predicate exit/reentry or next tick period
events.order: source final event definitions, numeric event ID order; clear before regen in same tick
events.actions: source ordinal order, queue nested activation, no reentrant double execution
events.unknown: invalid/unsupported commands fail closed into a persisted review flag; no silent reward/clear

rewards.transaction: consume requirements, RNG outcome, grant item/gold, map changes, quest flags and completion marker committed atomically
rewards.GETITEM: grant one unit of source item ID; chosen singleplayer behavior, original native main step does not directly grant
rewards.USEITEM: consume one; abort whole transaction if unavailable
rewards.GOLD: grant source amount locally; do not reinterpret as item ID based on text
rewards.conflict: 01 EVENT51 GOLD399 + key message stays flagged; no automatic key399 grant
rewards.repeat: idempotency key includes save-slot/scenario/event/actor scope/activation; reward ledger persists

respawn.scenario: no initial-enemy respawn on ordinary reentry/load; explicit replay creates new run and rewards no campaign unique objects twice
respawn.REGEN: authored: revive up to N completely dead10-slot groups, same planned cells if free; move to nearest valid cell if occupied
respawn.period: source TICK periods in virtual seconds; delay while scene dialogue/clear in progress
respawn.limits: one active instance per unit+generation; no boss/unique reward respawn; no reward from repeated farming waves
respawn.clear: cancel all pending waves and commit clear before respawn

save.unity_wire_shape: JsonUtility integration must use sorted List records for items/units/ledgers/map deltas, not Dictionary; Python dict is logical reference only

save.load: validate version/checksum/profile; no reroll, reward repetition, instant offline respawn, or defaulting corrupted data to valid new game
save.checkpoint: after completed reward/event transaction, victory/return, safe field save; not in the middle of unresolved transaction
